description: Resource Management sequence — the meta layer of the curriculum: how software is made well. Algorithmic complexity, data locality/caching, real-time vs offline, version control, testing/debugging, hardware.

big_o_complexity.name: Algorithmic Complexity (Big O)
big_o_complexity.description: The complexity race — one bar per Big-O class (O(1) to O(2^n)) growing as the input size n sweeps up. At small n they stand level; at large n the quadratic and exponential peg the ceiling and flash OFF CHART. Scale made visible.

parameters.n_max: Largest input size the sweep reaches (default 24)
parameters.sweep_seconds: Seconds for n to sweep 1 -> n_max (default 8)
parameters.freeze_n: If > 0, hold at this n (for stills) instead of animating
